::: {.callout-note}
## Source inspected
The PDF was read. It is a later training deck. It does not reproduce a 1993 ministry instrument.
:::

## Identification

| Element | As inspected |
| --- | --- |
| Cover line | “Presented by Paul Gauthier Individualized Funding Resource Centre Society and Spinal Cord Injury BC 3 part series” |
| URL | [IFRC Society PDF](https://www.ifrcsociety.org/documents/resources/slides/getting-started/SCI-Presentation-1.pdf) |
| Founding sentence | “Established by the Ministry of Health in British Columbia in 1993, with people with disabilities in the forefront of the program design.” |
| Other historical line on the same deck | A slide lists “1. The Agency 2. ECPM Enhanced Consumer Participation Model 3. People paid themselves” |

: Identification

## Annotation

This deck is one public source of the **1993** start-year claim. A different IFRC deck uses **1994**. Both are later slides. Neither is an inspected 1993–95 government record.

The ECPM line is a three-step schematic, not a dated publication list.

## Open questions

- Date the slides were prepared.
- Which, if any, ministry document the 1993 year is taken from.
